newsitem.title: JAPAN: BOJ drains 300 bln yen from market - traders.
newsitem.headline: BOJ drains 300 bln yen from market - traders.

text.p: The Bank of Japan (BOJ) drained a net 300 billion yen from the money market on Monday, money traders said.
Before the operation, the market had a net surplus of about 300 billion yen.
The central bank returned to a neutral stance in its daily money market operation on Monday after conducting accommodative operations for six consecutive sessions since February 28, traders said.
The key overnight call rate was traded at 0.48 and 0.49 percent after the operation, up from Friday's weighted average rate of 0.45 percent, they said.
